Drop element writes nothing for an inline data image

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Before <img src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="icon"> after</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(inline_data_media: 'DropElement'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
